race.description: Nalder Family Country Boosted Showcase Hcp (C3)
race.comment: NIELSEN PARK (1) confidence is high and looks one of the leading contenders in this vein of form. Found the line well with the 59kg for a narrow second over 1600m at Scone. Will be winding up late in a easier contest. SNOW DOG (3) maps well for this and the visors go on. Rewarded for his consistency with a comfortable on speed win as fav over 1600m at Narromine. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot score again. YORKEL (4) now in the Kieren Hazelton yard. Gripped on late to hold fifth over 1400m at Bathurst. Proven at the mile and ticks a few boxes today. SURPASSER (6) ready for the 1600m and should appreciate the firmer track after he struggled in the heavy going when sixth over 1300m at Dubbo. Place preferred. DUAL AWARD (2) near his top for this third up and expect to see him a touch closer in the run today.
